habitat.description:
The snow leopard inhabits the highest and most rugged mountain terrain on the planet, threading between rocky outcrops and scree slopes at altitudes of 3,000 to 5,500 metres across the great ranges of Central Asia. These ghost cats move through a world of thin air, extreme cold, and breathtaking vertical landscapes that would challenge any living creature.

In summer, snow leopards follow their prey into alpine meadows where blue sheep and ibex graze on sparse grasses between granite boulders. The cats use ridgelines and cliff edges as travel corridors, their pale grey coats blending perfectly with the lichen-covered rock.

Winter drives both predator and prey to lower elevations, where snow leopards navigate frozen river valleys and sparse juniper forests. Their extraordinarily long, thick tails serve as both balance aids on precipitous terrain and warming scarves wrapped around their faces during blizzards.

threats.name: Retaliatory Killing
threats.description: Herders kill snow leopards in retaliation for livestock predation, which can represent a significant economic loss for mountain communities.

threats.name: Poaching
threats.description: Illegal trade in pelts and bones drives targeted hunting, with snow leopard parts entering black markets across Asia.

threats.name: Mining and Infrastructure
threats.description: Road construction and mining operations fragment high-altitude habitats and disturb denning sites.

threats.name: Climate Change
threats.description: Rising temperatures push the tree line upward, shrinking alpine habitat and altering prey distribution patterns.

threats.name: Prey Base Decline
threats.description: Competition with domestic livestock for grazing reduces wild ungulate populations that snow leopards depend upon.

key_programs: Global Snow Leopard & Ecosystem Protection Program

cultural_significance.cinema: Planet Earth II brought unprecedented footage of snow leopards hunting on impossible cliff faces, captivating global audiences.
cultural_significance.literature: Peter Matthiessen's "The Snow Leopard" transformed this elusive cat into a literary symbol of spiritual seeking and wildness.
cultural_significance.mythology: Revered as mountain spirits across Central Asian cultures, snow leopards appear in Tibetan Buddhist iconography and Kyrgyz folklore.
cultural_significance.media_presence: The difficulty of filming snow leopards makes every documentary appearance a landmark event, with some crews waiting years for footage.
cultural_significance.cultural_paradox: Known as the "ghost of the mountains," the snow leopard's mystique grows even as climate change erodes its high-altitude realm.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: A snow leopard breaks into the sheep pen of a nomad and kills nine rams. Father and son then argue: the son insists on killing the snow leopard, but the father insists on releasing it.

tmdb_media.title: Leopard in the Snow
tmdb_media.overview: A tender romance develops between an attractive young woman and a famous race car driver who lives incognito after supposedly being killed in an auto accident.

tmdb_media.title: The Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: A composer meets with her composition teacher to help put the final touches on a new piece she is writing for string quartet.

tmdb_media.title: The Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: It is about veteran photographer, who've been taking a pictures all his life and whose dream is to take a photograph of snow leopard. He chasing it in the world's greatest mountain ranges, the Himalayas.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard Sisters
tmdb_media.overview: In Nepal’s remote Dolpo region, two Indigenous women form an unlikely friendship to save one of the planet’s most mysterious and vulnerable wild cats: the snow leopard.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard Secret War
tmdb_media.overview: Snow Leopard Secret War is set in 1943, when the war in the pacific was still going on, causing the Japanese army to be affected and had to switch to defense mode. However, they were carrying out another battle plan, a large-scale attack began, they also tasked agents with lying in the area and illegally transporting weapons. . At this time, the leader of the Independent Troupe Tiger Tou Son Bat Lo Luu Vien found the spies and successfully prevented an impending war.

tmdb_media.title: The Snow Leopard Calling
tmdb_media.overview: Disturbed by how herders trap and torture snow leopards by the herders, Tshiring, a young conservationist from Dolpo who researches snow leopards feels a sense of urgency to protect the last of these endangered big cats. She is convinced this can only happen if local communities are involved in protecting the animals—but also benefit from snow leopards. She takes on a challenging research expedition over three harsh winter months in an empty village to explore the possibility of organizing a snow leopard conservation trek that could help change locals’ perception about the need to protect snow leopards.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard: Beyond the Myth
tmdb_media.overview: BBC The Natural World.  In 2004, a team from the Planet Earth series captured the first ever film of a wild snow leopard in the mountains of Pakistan. For Nisar Malik, who led the expedition, these images sparked a passion that compelled him to return. With cameraman Mark Smith, he spent two years documenting the snow leopard's daily life, finally lifting the veil on the most elusive of all cats.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard of Afghanistan
tmdb_media.overview: Afghanistan, one of the most dangerous places on earth, is home to a population of endangered and elusive snow leopards.

tmdb_media.title: The Descendant of the Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: Set in the remote Kyrgyz mountains, The Descendant of the Snow Leopard tells the story of a resilient nomadic tribe whose survival and spiritual identity are deeply connected to the elusive snow leopard. Based on a traditional Kyrgyz folktale, the film explores themes of courage, heritage, and humanity’s bond with nature, as one family confronts harsh environments, moral dilemmas, and cultural transformation in Soviet-era Central Asia.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard: Soul of the Tiger
tmdb_media.overview: Spin-off of war drama «Snow Leopard» (2010) from perspective of Xu Hu character  In 1944, Zhou Weiguo secretly dispatched Xu Hu, a member of the Snow Leopard Special Forces, to the Japanese Japanese Police Command to rescue the arrested Soviet Red Army intelligence officer Tian Chong. The rescued Tian Chong brought intelligence on the border defense map of the Kanto Army. Zhou Weiguo agreed to let Xu Hu cooperate with the military headquarters to fight in the north. A carefully arranged lethal trap was waiting for the Snow Leopard Special Forces.

tmdb_media.title: The Descendant of the Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: The Russian Descendant of the Snow Leopard is based on a famous Kirghizian folktale. Apparently the Kirghizian folks had plenty of time to tell this story: to print a full synopsis would result in a novelette. Essentially, the story involves a proud group of highland hunters called the Snow Leopards, who in order to survive a brutal winter must request help from the Lowland people. The price for this assistance is the hand of the Snow Leopard's daughter, who is promised in marriage to a wealthy Lowland trader. During the Springtime wedding celebration, the trader becomes fascinated by a stranger who wins all the athletic contests. This "male" contestant turns out to be a woman, who has arrived to seek freedom for her imprisoned husband. The subsequent romance between the trader and the beautiful stranger results in disaster and bloodshed for both the Snow Leopards and the Lowlanders.

tmdb_media.title: Snow Leopard of the Carpathians
tmdb_media.overview: The film gives the viewer the opportunity to learn more about the work of mountain rescuers in the Carpathians, and hear the touching and incredible stories of rescuing tourists lost in the mountains and survived.

tmdb_media.title: The Frozen Kingdom of the Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: Join the big cats as we get up close and personal with their journeys through growing pains, adulthood, survival struggles and unfamiliar territories. These seven films follow the lives of some of the most formidable feline predators - lions, leopards, tigers and cheetahs in intimate detail.

tmdb_media.title: Ghost of The Mountain: The Story of The Elusive Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: “High in the mountains, a ghost walks among the snow.”  In the remote and frozen landscapes of Ladakh, the snow leopard moves silently, almost unseen. It is one of the rarest and most mysterious big cats in the world.  "Ghost of The Mountain" follows the journey of a wildlife photographer searching for this secretive predator. But he is not alone. Along the way, he meets the people who live in these harsh lands— herders, trackers, and conservationists— who work every day to protect the snow leopard and find ways to live alongside it.  Through their stories, we explore the delicate balance between survival and coexistence, between ancient traditions and modern conservation.

tmdb_media.title: The Suori Family and the Snow Leopard
tmdb_media.overview: When the snow leopards come down from the mountains, they decimate the flocks, as the Suori family and the filmmaker stand by helpless.
